title: Preferences
lead: These settings are saved in this browser only.

fontScale.label: Text size
fontScale.hint: Scales all text and controls of the app.

density.label: Density
density.hint: Compact puts more on the screen; the map keeps its size.

paletteLayout.label: Device list
paletteLayout.hint: Where the device list sits in the workspace. Applies on wide screens; on phones the list always opens from the bottom.

deviceDetails.label: Device details
deviceDetails.hint: In a window: double-click a device on the map or press Enter; windows can be moved, resized and minimised, and several can stay open at once. Applies on wide screens; on phones the details always open from the bottom.
deviceDetails.window: In a separate window (like Packet Tracer)

deviceStyle.label: Device style
deviceStyle.hint: How devices are drawn on the map, in the device list and in the device details.

linkLights.label: Link lights
linkLights.hint: The light at the switch end of a cable: green when the link is up.

snap.label: Snap to grid
snap.hint: Moved devices land on the grid.

minimap.label: Minimap
minimap.hint: Shown on screens 768 px and wider.

animation.label: Animate packets
animation.hint: Off: packets jump to the end of each step. Your system's reduced-motion setting turns the animation off too.

defaultMode.label: Start in
defaultMode.hint: Used when a lab, exercise or sample opens.

defaultEventFilters.label: Protocols the event list shows at the start

cliDefault.label: Open network devices on the CLI tab
cliDefault.hint: Routers and switches open on CLI instead of Info.

historyLength.label: Command history length
historyLength.hint: Up and Down walk back through this many commands. Device CLIs keep at most 10 per mode for now (the IOS default).
historyLength.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

autoCable.label: Offer the automatic cable
autoCable.hint: Off: the toolbar and the palette list only real cable types, so you pick each cable yourself.

language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Device output stays in English, like on real equipment.

autosave.label: Autosave the lab
autosave.hint: Off: changes in the free lab are not saved in this browser. Export the lab from the File menu to keep it.

file.heading: Preferences file
file.lead: Take your preferences to another browser.
file.importedWithIgnored_one: Preferences imported. {{count}} invalid setting was reset to its default.
file.importedWithIgnored_other: Preferences imported. {{count}} invalid settings were reset to their defaults.
file.invalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
file.notPreferences: This file is not an Octetlab preferences file.
file.readFailed: The file could not be read.

resetPreferences.heading: Default preferences
resetPreferences.confirm: Reset every preference on this screen to its default?

progress.heading: Reset progress
progress.lead: Marks the chosen kinds as not done again. Saved labs stay.
progress.confirm: Reset the progress of the selected kinds? This cannot be undone. The page reloads.

clear.heading: Clear local data
clear.lead: Deletes everything this app saved in this browser: labs, progress, preferences, language and palette favourites.
clear.confirm: Delete all local data of this app? This cannot be undone. Export the labs you want to keep first. The home page opens afterwards.
clear.failed: Local data could not be cleared completely. Try again, or clear the site data in the browser settings.
